description: Apply the high-fidelity design system to the existing workspace. Restyle every surface — grid, lightbox, topbar, thumbnails, summary — to match the design handoff. Add the ProgressRail, scene headers with timestamps, filmstrip in lightbox, keyboard legend, and toast notifications. This transforms the working prototype into a polished photo tool.
designReference: design/design_handoff_photodesk/README.md — tokens, layout specs, interaction patterns are final.
principles: Visual fidelity to the design reference — tokens, spacing, radii, typography are final
Keep existing backend untouched — this is a frontend-only feature
No new dependencies — vanilla CSS and JS only
Keyboard-first — every interaction works without a mouse
Dark-only — neutral graphite chrome so photos are judged without color bias
Incremental — each story produces a visible, testable improvement

techStack.fonts: Hanken Grotesk (sans, 400/500/600/700) + JetBrains Mono (mono, 400/500/600) via Google Fonts link
techStack.colorSystem: OKLCH via CSS custom properties (design/design_handoff_photodesk/theme.css is the source)
techStack.backend: No backend changes in this feature

fileStructure.description: All changes in public/. styles.css gets a full rewrite from the design tokens. index.html gets structural updates. app.js gets UI logic additions.
touchedFiles: public/styles.css — full rewrite: design tokens, component styles, responsive grid, lightbox, filmstrip
public/index.html — structural: ProgressRail markup, scene headers, filmstrip container, toast container, keyboard legend
public/app.js — logic: ProgressRail interactivity, filmstrip rendering, scene timestamps, keyboard focus in grid, toast system, Enter/Shift+Enter scene navigation in lightbox

userStories.title: Design tokens and base styles
acceptanceCriteria: Rewrite styles.css with all CSS custom properties from theme.css (neutrals, accent, semantic, typography, radii, shadows, motion)
Import Hanken Grotesk (400,500,600,700) and JetBrains Mono (400,500,600) via Google Fonts link in index.html
Body uses --bg background, --text color, --sans font family
Add .mono utility class: --mono font, font-feature-settings tnum, letter-spacing 0.02em
Add .kbd utility: inline kbd style matching the design (panel-2 bg, border, small mono text)
Scrollbar styling: thin, --panel-3 thumb, transparent track
All existing elements inherit the new token system (no visual regressions in layout)
userStories.notes: This is the foundation — every subsequent story builds on these tokens. Copy OKLCH values exactly from theme.css.

userStories.title: Topbar and ProgressRail
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the flat mode-tab buttons with the ProgressRail component from the design
Rail layout: Cull -> Rate -> Stack -> Commit as a connected horizontal sequence with connector lines
Each step: circular status indicator (accent when active, green check when prior pass done), label, live count chip
Connector lines fill with accent color as you progress through passes
Clicking any step switches to that pass (same as current tab behavior)
Clicking Commit opens the summary screen
Topbar is 3-column grid: left (Home + session name in 14/600 + mono metadata), center (rail), right (Hide rejects + filter select + Summary removed since Commit is in rail)
Session name and 'N frames · N scenes' metadata shown in topbar left
All topbar elements use correct tokens (--panel background, --border-soft bottom border)
userStories.notes: The ProgressRail is the signature navigation element. Reference workspace.jsx ProgressRail function. The 'Summary' button goes away — Commit step in the rail replaces it.

userStories.title: Scene headers and grid layout
acceptanceCriteria: Scene separators show: 'Scene N' label + timestamp (from first asset's fileCreatedAt, format HH:MM) + frame count ('N frames')
Scene header: left-aligned label in 13px/600 with mono timestamp and frame count, horizontal rule across remaining width
Grid uses CSS flex-wrap with --thumb width variable (default ~200px) and --grid-gap (default 10px)
Thumbnails are aspect-ratio aware: apply the photo's aspect ratio to the grid item (requires storing aspect ratio per asset — use width/height from Immich asset response)
Grid items have --r-sm (5px) border radius with overflow hidden
Proper spacing: 4px base rhythm, section spacing 28-44px between scenes
userStories.notes: Requires backend change: store asset width/height (or aspect ratio) when creating sessions. The Immich search response includes width and height fields per asset. Store in a new asset_meta column on scenes or a separate table. Alternatively, store the full asset list with metadata in the scenes table's asset_ids JSON (expand from just IDs to [{id, ar, file, time}]).

userStories.title: Thumbnail component restyling
acceptanceCriteria: Focus ring: 2px solid accent with 0 0 0 4px accent-dim glow on the focused thumbnail
Keep status: green (--keep) outline, small green dot badge top-left with checkmark
Reject status: red (--reject) outline, red X badge top-left, dark scrim overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.42))
Star ratings: gold stars (--star color) shown at bottom of thumbnail over a subtle gradient
Stack mode: checkbox replaces status badge top-left (accent when selected, translucent dark when not)
Stack group badge: accent-colored link icon + group number badge top-right
Hover state: reveal quick-action buttons (keep/reject in Cull mode, maximize always) over a bottom gradient
Reject thumbnails dim to 40% opacity in Stack mode
Existing pick/reject/star/stack visual indicators all update to use new token colors
userStories.notes: The Thumb component in workspace.jsx is the reference. The hover quick-actions are a nice touch for mouse users but keyboard is primary.

userStories.title: Pass hint strip and keyboard legend
acceptanceCriteria: Below the topbar, a centered one-line hint for the current pass with an icon
Cull: checkmark icon + 'Keep or reject, fast.'
Rate: star icon + 'Star the survivors.'
Stack: layers icon + 'Group same-shot variants.'
Bottom of screen: sticky keyboard shortcut legend bar, content changes per pass
Cull: P Keep · X Reject · U Unset · ←→ Move · ↵ Open · E Edit
Rate: 1-5 Rate · 0 Clear · X Reject · ←→ Move · ↵ Open · E Edit
Stack: Space/click Select · G Group · ←→ Move · ↵ Open
In lightbox: legend updates to show lightbox-specific shortcuts (Enter = next scene, Shift+Enter = prev scene, Esc = close)
Legend uses .kbd styling for key indicators, muted text for labels
userStories.notes: The hint strip is subtle but important UX — reminds the user what mode they're in without being intrusive.

userStories.title: Lightbox redesign
acceptanceCriteria: Full-screen fixed overlay with --bg-deep background
Header: close X button (top-left), mono filename, 'i / N' counter, Edit button (top-right)
Center stage: image with max-width 1200px, drop shadow (--shadow-3), rounded corners
Large circular prev/next navigation buttons on either side of the image (outside the image bounds)
Status badge: large keep/reject indicator overlaid on image top-right when set
Interactive star rating row centered below the image (clickable + keyboard 1-5)
Stars use --star color (gold), empty stars use --text-ghost
Enter key jumps to first frame of NEXT scene; Shift+Enter jumps to first frame of PREVIOUS scene
Escape closes lightbox and returns focus to the grid item that was open
userStories.notes: Reference lightbox.jsx Lightbox function. The scene-jumping via Enter/Shift+Enter is a key workflow improvement — lets you skip through scenes without going back to the grid.

userStories.title: Filmstrip in lightbox
acceptanceCriteria: Horizontal scrollable strip of thumbnails below the main image, above the keyboard legend
Thumbnails are 64px tall, aspect-ratio aware
Active thumbnail has accent ring + auto-centers in the strip on navigation
Status dot overlay (green/red) and star count visible on filmstrip thumbnails
Clicking a filmstrip thumbnail navigates to that photo
Strip scrolls smoothly to keep the active thumbnail centered
Filmstrip respects current filters (hidden rejects don't appear)
userStories.notes: The filmstrip is key for spatial awareness — you can see where you are in the sequence and jump to any photo. Auto-centering on navigation is critical.

userStories.title: Grid keyboard focus navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Arrow keys move focus between thumbnails in the grid (left/right within a scene, wrapping to next/prev scene)
Focused thumbnail has the accent ring + glow from VW-004
Auto-scroll: grid scrolls to keep focused thumbnail visible (with 70px top padding, 20px bottom padding)
Enter or O opens the lightbox on the focused thumbnail
E opens the editor on the focused thumbnail (placeholder for Phase 3)
Pass-specific keys work on the focused thumbnail: P/X/U in Cull, 1-5/0/X in Rate, Space to toggle selection in Stack
G in Stack mode groups current selection (same as Group as Stack button)
Focus persists when switching passes (stays on the same photo if still visible)
userStories.notes: This enables full keyboard-only culling from the grid without ever opening the lightbox. Reference shell.jsx keyboard handler. The grid needs data-pid attributes on thumbnails for focus tracking.

userStories.title: Toast notifications
acceptanceCriteria: Toast system: fixed position bottom-center, styled card with check icon
Toast auto-dismisses after ~2.4 seconds
Toast shown on: stack group created ('Grouped N frames into stack M')
Toast styling: --panel-2 background, --border-strong border, --shadow-3, 13.5px text, green check icon
Only one toast visible at a time (new toast replaces existing)
userStories.notes: Toasts will also be used in Phase 3 for edit saves. Keep the implementation generic.

userStories.title: Summary / Commit screen restyling
acceptanceCriteria: Centered card layout (max-width 560px) matching the design
Eyebrow text: session name in mono uppercase
'Commit to Immich' as the main heading
2x3 grid of stat tiles: Kept (green), Rejected (red), Undecided (neutral), Rated (gold), Stacks (accent), Edited (accent, shows 0 for now)
Each stat tile: colored number, uppercase label, panel background with border
'What to push' section: four checkbox rows with colored dot, title, mono sub-detail
Four rows: Trash rejects, Write star ratings, Create stacks, Upload edited versions (disabled/0 for now)
'Commit to Immich ->' primary button (accent color, full width)
Live progress log: each action appends a green check line as it completes, ending with 'Done. Immich is up to date.'
userStories.notes: The fourth checkbox (Upload edited versions) is a placeholder for Phase 3 — show it but disable or show 0 count. The live progress log replaces the current all-at-once result display.

medium: Aspect-ratio-aware thumbnails require storing width/height from Immich — needs a minor backend+DB change in VW-003
OKLCH color support: requires modern browsers (Chrome 111+, Safari 15.4+, Firefox 113+) — acceptable for a self-hosted tool
Grid keyboard navigation with flex-wrap: arrow key movement across rows needs careful index math
low: Font loading: Google Fonts link is straightforward, self-hosting is a later optimization
Filmstrip auto-centering: scrollIntoView with smooth behavior handles most cases
Toast timing: simple setTimeout, no complex queue needed
